findings.finding: H-37, H-39, H-41 and H-42 name no guard measure and region 5 lists guards for H-38/H-40/H-43/H-44 only, so H-41 (dry c2) and H-42 (pre-approved GO chains, which remove monitor checks) can read SUPPORTED while later-found defects rise.
findings.requiredChange: append to H-41 and H-42 "and later-found defects per post slot (median) do not exceed the pre median of slots 285 to 287 (section 4)"; append to H-37 and H-39 "Guard: none; the report states that no guard is tested"; region 5 list becomes "(H-38 overshoot, H-40, H-41 and H-42 defects, H-43 machinery MAJOR, H-44 slips)".

findings.finding: Region 5 tests a guard "rose above its pre value", but H-38's pre value is a single confounded overshoot on the excluded day 2026-11-12, the bridge baseline lists unclassified 5-hour stops at 97 % and 95 % on Nov 11-12, and §2 requires zero; the comparator is ambiguous.
findings.requiredChange: "Region 5 reads each guard against the comparator stated in section 2: H-38 zero unconfounded overshoots in post windows; H-40 to H-43 post median at most the pre median; H-44 post median at most 0. Pre-period overshoots are reported descriptively."

findings.finding: Stopping "at the earlier of the minimum n reached for every hypothesis or 2026-11-26" can truncate the declared post windows (days to 11-19, slots to 292), and a post slot merging after Nov 19 cannot close its 7-day issue window by Nov 26.
findings.requiredChange: "The study stops at 2026-11-26 or, if earlier, when every declared post unit is complete (2026-11-19 ended, the last post slot at PACKET r1, every post slot's 7-day issue window closed); reaching the minimum n does not stop collection. A slot whose 7-day window is open at the stop has postMergeIssues7d missing."

findings.finding: Slot 288 is a post slot for H-40, yet its contract/source/reader rounds (2/2/2) were seen before the freeze and sit in the pre-constant column, and the cap reached R00 inside 288 (bridge step 4 "rule to R00 at 288"), so 288 is transitional.
findings.requiredChange: "H-40: pre slots 285 to 287; slot 288 excluded (transitional: the cap reached R00 inside it and its rounds were seen at the freeze); post slots 289 to 292" and drop "288: contract 2, source 2, reader 2" from the pre-constant column.

findings.finding: 22.2 is itself rounded (532/24 = 22.1667) and 18.87 = 0.85 x 22.2, not 0.85 x 22.1667 = 18.842; 365K vs 0.75 x 487K = 365.25K is undeclared; both conflict with "computed on the raw values, never on rounded ones".
findings.requiredChange: "The H-44 thresholds 365K tokens and 18.87 minutes are absolute constants fixed at this freeze from the rounded baselines 487K and 22.2; the raw-values rule applies to post values and to ratios of medians."

findings.finding: PREREG H-43 guard is "the pre median" (288, plus 287 "where the monitor can reconstruct") while the register says "do not exceed 4 (slot 288's count)"; a post-freeze reconstruction of 287 would move the baseline.
findings.requiredChange: "machinery MAJOR findings per post slot (median) do not exceed 4 (slot 288)"; §3:77 "slot 288 (single-slot baseline); 287's counts, if reconstructed, are descriptive only".

findings.finding: Missing material confounders: (a) intervention fidelity (no record that /autocompact 500k was typed, a GO chain issued, a dry c2 run, per unit); (b) other changes inside the post window (steps 5-8, new conventions, model or effort changes, monitor session restarts that reset context per call); (c) slot 288 baseline partly exposed to H1-H4, all landed during it on 11-12; (d) the bundle row covers H-37..H-39 only though H5-H8 all start at 289 (§9:175).
findings.requiredChange: add rows "| intervention fidelity | `fidelity` {h1..h8: true/false} per day and slot | a unit without its intervention is excluded from that hypothesis and counted |", "| other changes in the post window (steps 5 to 8, conventions, model or effort, monitor session restarts) | dated `changes[]` {date, kind} | later units flagged; all post units flagged gives U3 |", "| slot 288 partly exposed to H1 to H4 | none | H-41 to H-44 carry the tag 'baseline partly treated' |"; bundle row: "H-37 to H-39 cannot be separated, nor H-41 to H-44 (H5 to H8 all start at slot 289); each verdict names the bundle".

findings.finding: The confounded-overshoot test needs the usage percent at fan-out start, but `overshoots[]` has only `fanOutInWindow` (type undefined) nested under per-session days although windows are account-level; `slots[]` has no product/machinery kind for H-43's "post product slot".
findings.requiredChange: "top-level `windows[]` {`windowEnd`, `usageAtStop`, `fanOut3PlusStartUsage` (percent or null)}; `slots[]` gains `kind` (product or machinery); H-43's minimum is 3 post product slots."

findings.finding: Only `meterSha256` is held fixed across deliveries; the extractor can change silently.
findings.requiredChange: "the evaluator refuses a delivery whose `meterSha256` or `extractSha256` differs from the first delivery's, and the register row records both."
